title: Validate and gate tool calls before they run
checks: Every problem is named by field

validate({'order_id': '104233', 'amount': 750, 'currency': 'JPY', 'urgent': True}, _schema()) == sorted(['amount: above maximum', "currency: not one of ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP']", 'order_id: does not match pattern', 'urgent: not allowed'])
Missing fields and wrong types are caught; a boolean is not a number
Unknown tools and invalid calls never run

execute({'tool': 'wire_money', 'args': {}}, REGISTRY) == {'ok': False, 'error': 'unknown tool'} and execute({'tool': 'create_refund', 'args': {'order_id': 'x', 'amount': 1, 'currency': 'USD'}}, REGISTRY)['ok'] is False and REFUNDS == []
A large refund waits for a human
execute({'tool': 'create_refund', 'args': {'order_id': 'ORD-000002', 'amount': 250, 'currency': 'USD'}}, REGISTRY) == {'ok': False, 'error': 'approval required'} and REFUNDS == []
Approved or small refunds run once

execute({'tool': 'create_refund', 'args': {'order_id': 'ORD-000002', 'amount': 250, 'currency': 'USD'}}, REGISTRY, approved=True)['ok'] and execute({'tool': 'create_refund', 'args': {'order_id': 'ORD-000003', 'amount': 20, 'currency': 'EUR'}}, REGISTRY)['ok'] and REFUNDS == [('ORD-000002', 250), ('ORD-000003', 20)]
